description:
Mint a one-time link that a human opens in a browser to take ownership of this workspace: they set an email and password, and can attach payment to buy more capacity. Give the link to the person. You never need to open it, and you cannot use it yourself.

    USE WHEN:
    - A run was refused with errorCode VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: the workspace is on the Free plan, and the person must take it over and complete the Verify page: a verified mobile and a card (it is not charged on the Free plan). If this tool then returns 409 workspace-claimed, do not call it again: the owner or an admin signs in to the TotalPath web app (the same environment as this server) and completes its Verify page (path /verify)
    - Free capacity is running low or exhausted (getWorkspaceUsage) and the person wants to keep going
    - verifyAnchorCode returned freeGrantOutcome not-owed or refused
    - The person wants to see the workspace, its call history or its keys in the TotalPath web app
    - The person asks how to pay

    WHAT YOU GET BACK (201):
    - url: the link. Valid for ONE HOUR and usable ONCE. Pass it to the person as-is.
    - expiresAt: when it stops working

    AFTER THE PERSON CLAIMS:
    Your API key keeps working exactly as before. The person now owns the workspace, can see everything you did, and can buy capacity that your key can then spend. Nothing you need to do.

    WHEN IT IS REFUSED:
    - 409 with reason workspace-claimed: a human already owns this workspace, so no more claim links can be issued. Tell the person to sign in to the TotalPath web app instead. If capacity is the concern, call getWorkspaceUsage first: when what is left is not enough for the work planned, the owner or an admin buys capacity under Settings, Billing (path /platform/settings/billing). Only if a run was refused with VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, they also complete the Verify page (path /verify).
    - 503: the link could not be issued just now. Try again shortly.

    A link that expires unused is harmless. Call this again for a fresh one.

    RELATED TOOLS:
    - getWorkspaceUsage: check the balance before deciding whether the person needs to pay
    - verifyAnchorCode: must have succeeded before the workspace can do anything worth paying for
name: getClaimLink

url.description: The token is in the fragment, after `#t=`.

title: Get a Link for a Human to Claim This Workspace
